subject: CI: add make test-unit to macOS build and auto-detect Homebrew LLVM path (#4123)
reason: The change is purely build/CI infrastructure: it edits the GitHub Actions macOS workflow (installs llvm/googletest earlier, sets CC/CXX/AR/RANLIB as job env, runs make test-unit) and adds Homebrew LLVM path auto-detection to src/unit/Makefile, which only affects compiling the unit-test harness on macOS. No server, replication, persistence, command, or tool behaviour changes, so there is nothing a fuzzer scenario against a running server could reach.
